source: Black & Gold Dispatch big board — our own ranking, not copied from any outside board
method: Score = production percentile within position from CollegeFootballData.com season stats (0-40; 2025 counts half) + recruiting pedigree (0-25) + conference level (0-10) + class (0-5) + size fit (0-5) + 10 if on our Steelers watch list, times a position-value factor (QB 1.15 ... RB 0.88). Linemen have no box-score stats, so they get a flat production score. Grade = 45-95 scale relative to our #1. Juniors and seniors in 2026 rosters only; players can return to school. Fan opinion, not a scouting report.
